description: This file defines the DeviceProfileService class, an Angular service responsible for managing device profiles, including fetching, saving, deleting, and configuring device profiles and related security and LWM2M objects.

classes.name: DeviceProfileService
classes.description: An Angular service for managing device profiles, including CRUD operations, security info retrieval, and LWM2M object management.

methods.name: getDeviceProfiles
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of device profiles.

methods.name: getDeviceProfilesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves device profile info objects by their IDs.

methods.name: getDeviceProfile
methods.description: Fetches a specific device profile by ID.

methods.name: exportDeviceProfile
methods.description: Exports a device profile, possibly with inline images.

methods.name: getLwm2mObjects
methods.description: Retrieves LWM2M objects with optional filtering.

methods.name: getLwm2mBootstrapSecurityInfo
methods.description: Gets LWM2M bootstrap security info, with caching.

methods.name: getLwm2mBootstrapSecurityInfoBySecurityType
methods.description: Gets security info based on security type, adjusting host/port accordingly.

methods.name: getLwm2mObjectsPage
methods.description: Retrieves a page of LWM2M objects.

methods.name: saveDeviceProfileAndConfirmOtaChange
methods.description: Saves a device profile after confirming OTA package update.

methods.name: deleteDeviceProfile
methods.description: Deletes a device profile by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets a device profile as default.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info for a specific device profile.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Retrieves paginated device profile info objects, optionally filtered by transport type.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileDevicesAttributesKeys
methods.description: Gets attribute keys for devices under a profile.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileDevicesTimeseriesKeys
methods.description: Gets timeseries keys for devices under a profile.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of device profile names, optionally only active ones.
